rows.event: Walk-in Interview for Agricultural Field Operator (AFO)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What are the posts available in ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available are Project Executive, Project Assistant, and Agricultural Field Operator. There are a total of 3 vacancies across these positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026 is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified dates.

faq.question: Q3. What are the walk-in interview dates for ICAR CRRI posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview dates are 19 August 2026 for Project Executive, 20 August 2026 for Project Assistant, and 21 August 2026 for Agricultural Field Operator.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR CRRI Project Executive, Project Assistant, Agricultural Field Operator posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 50 years of age. Age relaxation for SC, ST, and OBC candidates will be applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Executive at ICAR CRRI?
faq.answer: The Project Executive (PE) will receive a consolidated salary of ₹ 42,000/- per month plus a fixed travel allowance of ₹8,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICAR CRRI Walk-in Interview 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ICAR CRRI Walk-in Interview 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What qualifications are required for the Agricultural Field Operator post?
faq.answer: For Agricultural Field Operator (AFO), candidates need Matric with +2 vocational in agriculture related subject OR Matric with two years of working experience in agriculture field OR Matric with ITI in agriculture related subject.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these ICAR CRRI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Executive, Project Assistant, and Agricultural Field Operator posts involves a Written-cum-Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Central Rice Research Institute (ICAR CRRI) in Cuttack, Odisha, Pincode 753006. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact venue details.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational, experience, category certificates), a duly filled application form if required, and extra passport-size photographs.
